name: all
description: All visible commits plus ancestors of explicitly mentioned hidden commits.

name: ancestors
description: Ancestors of x, optionally limited by depth.

name: at_operation
description: Evaluate x against the repository state at a specific operation.

name: author
description: Author name or email matches a string pattern.

name: author_date
description: Author date matches a date pattern.

name: author_email
description: Author email matches a string pattern.

name: author_name
description: Author name matches a string pattern.

name: bisect
description: Pick commits where roughly half of x are descendants.

name: bookmarks
description: Local bookmark targets, optionally filtered by name pattern.

name: change_id
description: Commits matching a change ID prefix.

name: children
description: Children of x, optionally limited by depth.

name: coalesce
description: Return the first revset that does not evaluate to none().

name: commit_id
description: Commits matching a commit ID prefix.

name: committer
description: Committer name or email matches a string pattern.

name: committer_date
description: Committer date matches a date pattern.

name: committer_email
description: Committer email matches a string pattern.

name: committer_name
description: Committer name matches a string pattern.

name: conflicts
description: Commits with conflicted files.

name: connected
description: Connected ancestry and descendency graph for x.

name: description
description: Description matches a string pattern.

name: descendants
description: Descendants of x, optionally limited by depth.

name: diff_lines
description: Diff lines match text, optionally limited to files.

name: diff_lines_added
description: Added diff lines match text, optionally limited to files.

name: diff_lines_removed
description: Removed diff lines match text, optionally limited to files.

name: divergent
description: Divergent commits.

name: empty
description: Commits that modify no files.

name: exactly
description: Require x to resolve to exactly count commits.

name: files
description: Commits that modify files matching a fileset expression.

name: first_ancestors
description: First-parent ancestors of x, optionally limited by depth.

name: first_parent
description: First-parent parents of x, optionally limited by depth.

name: fork_point
description: Common fork point of all commits in x.

name: heads
description: Commits in x with no descendants also in x.

name: hidden
description: Hidden commits included in the current revset search space.

name: immutable
description: Commits that JJ treats as immutable.

name: immutable_heads
description: Heads of the immutable commit set.

name: builtin_immutable_heads
description: Default immutable head targets before user overrides.

name: latest
description: Latest commits in x by committer timestamp.

name: merges
description: Merge commits.

name: mine
description: Commits authored by the current user.

name: mutable
description: Commits that JJ treats as mutable.

name: none
description: No commits.

name: parents
description: Parents of x, optionally at a given depth.

name: present
description: Return x or none() if any target does not exist.

name: reachable
description: Commits reachable from srcs while staying inside domain.

name: remote_bookmarks
description: Remote bookmark targets, optionally filtered by name and remote.

name: remote_tags
description: Remote tag targets, optionally filtered by name and remote.

name: root
description: The virtual root commit.

name: roots
description: Commits in x with no ancestors also in x.

name: signed
description: Cryptographically signed commits.

name: subject
description: Subject line matches a string pattern.

name: tags
description: Tag targets, optionally filtered by name pattern.

name: trunk
description: Default trunk commit alias, usually resolving from the main upstream bookmark.

name: tracked_remote_bookmarks
description: Targets of tracked remote bookmarks, optionally filtered.

name: untracked_remote_bookmarks
description: Targets of untracked remote bookmarks, optionally filtered.

name: visible
description: Visible commits in the current revset search space.

name: visible_heads
description: All visible heads.

name: working_copies
description: Working-copy commits across all workspaces.

name: merge_point
description: Merge points of x.

name: untracked_remote_tags
description: Untracked remote tag targets.

name: forks
description: Commits with multiple children.

name: tracked_remote_tags
description: Tracked remote tags.

name: diff_contains
description: Deprecated alias of diff_lines.
